svg.title: The label "Wondering what's over" above the label "Hoverable", the latter spanned by a brace under it.
svg.desc: Used to demonstrate Calculable SVG elements that respond to style changes. The "Hoverable" label changes size on mouse hover using an animation to transition between sizes. The size of the under-brace is calculated from the size of the "Hoverable" label as the former changes.
